name: Haibara Ai
source:
Real name Miyano Shiho and code name Sherry, this former member of the Black Organization escaped by shrinking into a child with the same poison Conan took. She now goes to Teitan Elementary and is part of the Detective Boys.

Taken from the game's character profile.
